reviewed_from: genuine native Unity before/after PNG downloaded and inspected 2026-10-16

review.summary: The two reused pine instances and neutral scanned cliff are peripheral and nearly invisible at the actual strategic camera. Their placement does not materially improve the original large dark courtyard, squared cliff silhouettes, or distant backdrop relative to the supplied reference.
primary_visible_failures: cliff-cut silhouette still blocky and unresolved
existing perimeter trees mask new pines
castle frontage still lacks consistent architectural finish
review.recommendation: Preserve original gameplay/native scene, reject these three trial placements as an artistic change. Test Unity-only terrain material and light intervention separately, then revise high-screen-area architecture and cliff composition using only existing artist assets. Compare identical camera before/after and require independent judgment.
